description: This file defines the IInvokable interface, which represents an asynchronously invokable object within the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace. It includes methods for managing invocation targets, arguments, method information, and cancellation support.

classes.name: IInvokable
classes.description: An interface for objects that can be invoked asynchronously, supporting target management, argument handling, method info retrieval, and cancellation.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the invocation target object, which may be null.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the invocation target from an ITargetHolder instance.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes the target method and returns a Response wrapped in a ValueTask.

methods.name: GetArgumentCount
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments for the invocation.

methods.name: GetArgument
methods.description: Retrieves the argument at the specified index.

methods.name: SetArgument
methods.description: Sets the argument at the specified index.

methods.name: GetMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method to invoke.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the interface.

methods.name: GetActivityName
methods.description: Returns a combined name referring to both the interface and method.

methods.name: GetMethod
methods.description: Returns the MethodInfo object for the method to invoke, may be null.

methods.name: GetInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the Type object representing the interface.

methods.name: GetDefaultResponseTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default response timeout, if any.

methods.name: GetCancellationToken
methods.description: Returns the CancellationToken for the invocation, defaulting to CancellationToken.None.

methods.name: TryCancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the invocation; returns true if cancellation was requested.
